name: General Mills
fiscalYearEnd: Last Sunday of May (FY2026 ended May 31, 2026; EDGAR fiscal year end code 0530)
description: General Mills makes branded packaged food and pet food and sells it mostly to grocery chains, mass merchants and foodservice distributors. Its biggest categories are snacks (22.5% of FY2026 sales), cereal, convenient meals, pet food (Blue Buffalo), refrigerated and frozen dough (Pillsbury) and baking mixes (Betty Crocker). Money comes from selling boxes and bags at a price set with retailers, less trade promotion; volume is flat to falling in most US food aisles, so profit depends on price, mix and cost savings. Walmart alone was 22% of FY2026 net sales. FY2026 was a bad year: the company took a $1.5B goodwill impairment on its North America Pet unit and sold its US yogurt businesses, so reported operating profit fell 73% to $886M while adjusted operating profit was $2.8B. It also owns 50% of two joint ventures (Cereal Partners Worldwide with Nestle, and Haagen-Dazs Japan) whose sales are not in its net sales.

gics.note: Conventional filing: sector and sub-industry as shown in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That page does not list industry group or industry, so those are null rather than filled from memory. SEC SIC code 2040 (Grain Mill Products) from the EDGAR submissions record.

hq.note: EDGAR business address city is Minneapolis, MN; Wikipedia's S&P 500 list gives Golden Valley, Minnesota (see conflicts)

employees.note: About 30,000: about 15,000 in the US and 15,000 outside; about 12,000 in production and 18,000 non-production (FY2026 10-K Human Capital)

businessLines.name: North America Retail
businessLines.how: Retailers (Walmart is 31% of this segment) buy branded boxes, bags and frozen items at list price less trade promotion; each shopping trip repeats the sale, so results follow shelf price, promotion depth and units per store.
businessLines.description: Grocery-store and mass-merchant sales of snacks, cereal, convenient meals, dough and baking mixes, plus super-premium ice cream, in the US and Canada.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating profit; margin computed from the two reported figures. FY2025: $2,729.9M on $11,907.0M sales (73% of segment total). Net sales fell 11% including the yogurt divestitures; organic -3%.

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.how: Retail sales of the same kind of branded food sold to local grocers and distributors, priced and promoted country by country and translated from local currencies (so results swing with exchange rates). The two 50% joint ventures are equity-accounted, so General Mills books its share of their profit, not their sales.
businessLines.description: Packaged food sold outside North America (10-K: brands in 100 countries across six continents), including local brands.

businessLines.name: North America Pet
businessLines.how: Pet owners buy bags and cans repeatedly through pet specialty retailers, grocery and online; pricing and premium mix drive revenue, with the fixed cost of a brand-heavy, natural-ingredient recipe range.
businessLines.description: Blue Buffalo and other natural pet food and treats sold through pet specialty stores and grocery/mass channels; the FY2026 acquisition of Whitebridge Pet Brands is reported here (10-K MD&A).

operatingProfit.note: FY2025: $501.0M on $2,470.8M sales. Net sales +6% reported, organic -3%. A $1,500M goodwill impairment on this reporting unit and $303M brand impairments (Nudges, Uncle Toby's, True Chews) were booked in FY2026 outside segment profit.

businessLines.name: North America Foodservice
businessLines.how: Foodservice distributors and operators buy bulk and commercial-pack products on recurring orders; prices track ingredient costs and volume follows restaurant and school traffic.
businessLines.description: Cereal, snacks, dough, baking mixes and other products sold to restaurants, schools, convenience stores and other operators through distributors.

operatingProfit.note: FY2025: $355.4M on $2,300.9M sales. Net sales -6%, organic -1%.

brands.name: Blue Buffalo, Tiki Pets, Edgard & Cooper, Nudges, True Chews
brands.share: Pet class $2,766.4M, 15.0% of FY2026 net sales

brands.name: Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Bisquick, Progresso, Totino's, Old El Paso, Annie's
brands.share: Dough 13.0%, convenient meals 15.6%, baking mixes 10.5% of FY2026 net sales
